Description: Synced Spotify lyrics in place of the taskbar weather widget.
TrayHint: Without the icon, right-click the lyrics or launch the app again to open settings.
PickerHint: Click elements, including the lyrics: green appears on the taskbar; white stays hidden.
MinimizeHint: Minimize: show the compact player configured below.
CompactHint: Replaces the weather while music is paused (choose "Minimize player" above).
CompactWidthHint: Space for artwork and text; buttons add extra width. Never smaller than the weather widget.
ScrollHint: Instead of truncating with “…”. Uses slightly more CPU while scrolling.
WidthHint: Space for artwork and lyrics; buttons add extra width. Never smaller than the weather widget or overlapping other taskbar buttons.
OffsetHint: Positive values advance lyrics; negative values delay them.
CalibrationHint: Shows the widget with a dashed border even without music. Drag to move; scroll to change width. Manual placement overrides automatic detection.
DebugHint: Writes logs to a file and enables the diagnostics window in the tray menu.
UnavailableLyrics: No synced lyrics are available for this song.
LyricsError: Could not fetch lyrics. Retrying shortly.
VolumeDetail: Spotify volume: {0}% — scroll to adjust, click to mute
MediaError: Could not access Windows media sessions.
BackgroundNotice: Running in the background. Lyrics replace the weather widget when Spotify plays.
MixerVolume: Spotify volume in the Windows mixer (click to mute, scroll to adjust)
